hypothesis: β-caryophyllene produces CB2-dependent anti-inflammatory and antinociceptive effects
test_system_and_primary_test: Human CB2 binding plus cAMP/β-arrestin; primary human monocytes; then blinded rodent model
critical_controls: CB2 antagonist or knockout; CB1 counter-screen; vehicle; positive CB2 ligand
primary_endpoint: "Ki or EC50; cytokines; preregistered pain endpoint"
interpretation_boundary: Supports a CB2 mechanism only for the measured endpoint; not every promotional effect

hypothesis: (-)-α-pinene modulates GABAA signaling sufficiently to alter inhibitory transmission
test_system_and_primary_test: Recombinant human GABAA subtypes plus hippocampal-slice electrophysiology
primary_endpoint: GABA current potentiation; decay kinetics; subtype profile
interpretation_boundary: Modeling is not a direct binding assay; stereoisomer and dose must be resolved

hypothesis: linalool positively modulates GABAA receptors and reduces neuronal excitability
test_system_and_primary_test: Recombinant GABAA electrophysiology plus neuronal network preparation
critical_controls: Bicuculline or picrotoxin; flumazenil; diazepam; oxygenated metabolite panel
interpretation_boundary: Supports GABAA modulation under defined conditions; not human anxiolysis or sedation

hypothesis: borneol enantiomers enhance GABAA signaling and produce GABAA-dependent behavioral effects
test_system_and_primary_test: Compare (+)- and (-)-borneol in recombinant GABAA electrophysiology and a blinded rodent model
critical_controls: Bicuculline; flumazenil; isoborneol; camphor; motor-function control
primary_endpoint: GABA potentiation; subtype dependence; behavior without motor confounding
interpretation_boundary: Does not establish BBB or clinical claims without PK and exposure evidence

hypothesis: α-bisabolol inhibits α7 nicotinic receptors and may alter inflammatory signaling
test_system_and_primary_test: Human α7-nAChR patch clamp plus immune-cell cytokine assay
critical_controls: α7 antagonist or knockdown; nicotine/choline; GABAA counter-screen; vehicle
primary_endpoint: IC50; reversibility; cytokine change; α7 dependence
interpretation_boundary: Supports α7 action for the tested cellular endpoint; not broad anti-inflammatory efficacy

hypothesis: the behavioral effect of α-bisabolol is GABAA-dependent rather than 5-HT1A-dependent
test_system_and_primary_test: Blinded elevated-plus-maze replication with locomotor and sedation controls
critical_controls: Flumazenil; WAY-100635; open-field; rotarod; positive anxiolytic
primary_endpoint: Open-arm time and entries adjusted for locomotion
interpretation_boundary: Animal antagonist evidence does not establish human anxiolysis or receptor binding

hypothesis: β-myrcene activates or modulates TRPV1 concentration-dependently
test_system_and_primary_test: Human TRPV1-expressing HEK cells plus whole-cell patch clamp using free compound
critical_controls: TRPV1 knockout or non-expressing cells; capsazepine; capsaicin; vehicle; cytotoxicity
interpretation_boundary: Supports a compound-level TRPV1 lead; does not establish analgesia

hypothesis: nerolidol interacts with TRPV1 under defined assay conditions
test_system_and_primary_test: Repeat free-nerolidol concentration-response in human TRPV1-expressing cells
critical_controls: TRPV1 knockout; capsazepine; free versus nanoparticle formulation; cytotoxicity
primary_endpoint: TRPV1-dependent response attributable to free nerolidol
interpretation_boundary: Nanoparticle activity cannot be assigned to free nerolidol without formulation controls

hypothesis: terpineol effects in an inflammatory-depression model depend on CB1; CB2; and/or D2
test_system_and_primary_test: Recombinant CB1/CB2/D2 binding and function followed by blinded LPS mouse model
critical_controls: Selective antagonists; genetic or orthogonal confirmation; locomotor control; positive ligands
primary_endpoint: Binding or functional potency plus receptor-dependent behavior
interpretation_boundary: Antagonist blockade can reflect off-target or behavioral confounding

hypothesis: phytol modulates GABAA α2/α3 or 5-HT1A signaling
test_system_and_primary_test: Recombinant receptor functional assays before animal replication
critical_controls: Subtype-negative controls; bicuculline; WAY-100635; vehicle; locomotor control
primary_endpoint: Direct functional modulation and subtype selectivity
interpretation_boundary: Docking and mouse behavior nominate targets but do not establish binding

hypothesis: caryophyllene oxide causes sedation through a non-GABAA mechanism
test_system_and_primary_test: Validated receptor-panel screen followed by blinded behavioral replication
critical_controls: Flumazenil; pentobarbital; receptor antagonists; motor controls; vehicle
primary_endpoint: Receptor activity predicting behavior; sedation without motor toxicity
interpretation_boundary: A sedative phenotype without target evidence remains mechanistically unresolved

hypothesis: the two limonene enantiomers have distinct receptor or non-receptor activity profiles
test_system_and_primary_test: Identity-resolved enantiomer panel with receptor; inflammatory; and neuronal assays
critical_controls: d and l enantiomers; racemate; vehicle; oxidation-product controls
interpretation_boundary: A null screen leaves the promotional claims unresolved rather than disproved

hypothesis: reported antimicrobial or antioxidant effects are reproducible for isolated compounds
test_system_and_primary_test: Standardized microbial MIC/MBC and cell-free antioxidant assays
critical_controls: Positive and negative controls; solvent; growth-independent viability; redox-interference control
interpretation_boundary: These may be non-receptor effects; no human receptor mechanism should be inferred

hypothesis: a promotional claim is reproduced only when the exact compound causes the named effect in an exposure-relevant model
test_system_and_primary_test: Registered systematic review plus identity-resolved primary assay and PK package
critical_controls: Blinding; preregistration; assay validation; independent replication; exposure check
primary_endpoint: Effect-specific evidence grade with denominator and uncertainty
interpretation_boundary: Promote a claim only to the scope actually tested; database gaps are not biological absence
